target.title: fix(model-fallback): re-throw LiveSessionModelSwitchError for outer retry loop (#101676)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a user changes the model mid-turn (via `/model`, session_status model override, or cron job override) while the AI is actively generating a response, the run terminates with an error instead of retrying the turn against the newly-selected model.

**Evidence from the issue (#101676):**
```
info: live session model switch requested: claude-sonnet-5 -> claude-sonnet-4-6
warn: model_fallback_decision decision=candidate_failed ... fallbackConfigured=false
error: Embedded agent failed before reply: Live session model switch requested
```

## Why This Change Was Made

The `runWithModelFallback` loop catches `LiveSessionModelSwitchError` from the embedded runner. When the switch target is not a later fallback candidate, it was wrapping the error as `FailoverError` instead of letting it propagate to the outer retry loop. With no fallbacks configured, this reached `throwFallbackFailureSummary` producing `FallbackSummaryError` — not `LiveSessionModelSwitchError` — so the outer loop never caught it.

**Fix:** When the switch target is not in the candidate list at all (a genuine user-requested switch to a new model), re-throw `LiveSessionModelSwitchError` so the outer retry loop can restart with the new model. When the switch target IS in the candidate list but at a same/earlier position (a stale fallback-conflict switch), preserve the existing failover behavior so the fallback chain can advance to configured candidates.

The outer loop has bounded retries (`MAX_LIVE_SWITCH_RETRIES = 5` for subagents, `2` for main agent), preventing infinite loops. The existing `findLiveSessionModelSwitchRedirectIndex` redirect-to-later-candidate behavior is preserved unchanged.

Risk note: this touches the agent live-switch/fallback boundary. The stale-switch guard from #58496 is preserved via the `isLiveSessionModelSwitchTargetInCandidates` check.

## Evidence

### Live Behavior Proof

The fix is at the control-flow boundary of `runWithModelFallback`. Source-level verification of the three branches:

**Branch 1 — switch target is a later fallback candidate (redirect, unchanged):**
```
runWithModelFallback(primary="openai/gpt-4.1-mini", fallbacks=["anthropic/claude-haiku-3-5", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6"])
  → candidate 0 (gpt-4.1-mini) throws LiveSessionModelSwitchError(claude-sonnet-4-6)
  → findLiveSessionModelSwitchRedirectIndex finds claude-sonnet-4-6 at index 2
  → redirects to index 2, skips haiku ✓
```

**Branch 2 — switch target NOT in candidates (rethrow for #101676):**
```
runWithModelFallback(primary="anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6", fallbacks=[])
  → candidate 0 throws LiveSessionModelSwitchError(openrouter/deepseek-chat)
  → findLiveSessionModelSwitchRedirectIndex returns null (no later candidates)
  → isLiveSessionModelSwitchTargetInCandidates returns false
  → re-throws LiveSessionModelSwitchError → outer loop retries ✓
```

**Branch 3 — stale switch target IS in candidates (failover preserved from #58496):**
```
runWithModelFallback(primary="openai/gpt-4.1-mini", fallbacks=["anthropic/claude-haiku-3-5"])
  → candidate 0 throws LiveSessionModelSwitchError(gpt-4.1-mini) [same as current]
  → findLiveSessionModelSwitchRedirectIndex returns null
  → isLiveSessionModelSwitchTargetInCandidates returns true (in list at index 0)
  → wraps as FailoverError, continues to haiku → haiku succeeds ✓
```

### Focused Tests

```
pnpm test src/agents/model-fallback.test.ts       → 232 passed ✓
pnpm test src/agents/live-model-switch.test.ts    → 42 passed ✓
pnpm test src/agents/agent-command.live-model-switch.test.ts → 148 passed ✓
```

### Static Checks

```
pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/agents/model-fallback.ts src/agents/model-fallback.test.ts → passed ✓
git diff --check → passed ✓
```

### Changes

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/agents/model-fallback.ts` | +32 / -4 lines — add `isLiveSessionModelSwitchTargetInCandidates`, narrow rethrow |
| `src/agents/model-fallback.test.ts` | +47 / -18 lines — update 2 tests, restore 1 stale-switch test, add 2 new tests |

Closes #101676.
